description: An NgRx RxJS-based store scoped to a component or feature through its provider, with `select`, `updater` and `effect`.
A ComponentStore function that produces new state from the previous state and a value. Must be pure.
Runs side effects on a stream of inputs; the flattening operator inside decides how overlapping calls behave.
Reads ComponentStore state as a signal, easing migration from observables.
